opening: I have this constant feeling of restlessness.
I keep crossing and uncrossing my legs, over and over.
I was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia.
I started taking risperidone about 2 months ago.

opening.text: I was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started taking risperidone about two months ago. Since then, I've had this constant feeling of restlessness. I just can't stay still; I fidget a lot, keep crossing and uncrossing my legs over and over, and I keep pacing around.
